steps.en: Install the zb binary with the standalone installer (or the Homebrew tap)
steps.zh: 用独立安装脚本（或 Homebrew tap）装上 zb

steps.en: Creates its root under /opt/zerobrew with one sudo and puts its prefix on your PATH
steps.zh: sudo 一次建好 /opt/zerobrew，前缀加进 PATH

steps.en: Install packages by name or from your existing Brewfile
steps.zh: 按名字装包，或直接用现有的 Brewfile

steps.en: Resolves formulae from a local index of Homebrew's API and downloads Homebrew's own bottles
steps.zh: 按 Homebrew API 本地索引解析，下载官方 bottle

steps.en: Relocates each bottle in-process once and keeps the finished keg in a content-addressed store
steps.zh: 在进程内把每个 bottle 重定位一次，成品存进内容寻址仓库

steps.en: Clones the finished keg into the Cellar and links it into the prefix
steps.zh: 把成品克隆进 Cellar，并链接到前缀

value.en: The same Homebrew packages, without waiting on Ruby and per-file relocation — and a reinstall is a clone, not a rebuild
value.zh: 装的还是 Homebrew 的包，却不用再等 Ruby 和逐文件重定位——重装只是一次克隆，不是重新处理
